svg.title: How Spead AI is built
svg.desc: People: Company users, Admins. App: Web app. Services: API, Export engine, Agent workspaces. Data & AI: PostgreSQL 16, LLM providers, Connectors. Linux servers with systemd and nginx, Redis-backed rate limits, encrypted daily database backups and a health check every five minutes.
svg.text: The main parts and how data moves between them.
Linux servers with systemd and nginx, Redis-backed rate limits, encrypted daily database backups and a health check every five minutes.
